summary: Created Transport Adapter Evaluation v1, preserving the Communication Bus as the institutional messaging model while evaluating GitHub repository files, local filesystem/local broker, Gmail/email, Gotify, Q Mastery/MPT-style mailbox connectors, and a future Codex task status adapter. Included a recommendation matrix, near-term transport priorities, and a future-work note for Codex task status integration.
